# Simpl

> Simpl (simpl.pro) builds custom growth portals for high-ticket B2B companies in the United States. Its flagship, the Account Engine, reads the public record for every account in a client's market every night (inspections and citations, building permits, licenses, ownership changes, public bids and budget cycles), scores which accounts are worth a call right now, and shows the client's team the reason to call, a link to the official record behind it, and the person who decides. Simpl also sets up CRM and follow-up sequences and builds 24/7 AI receptionist and support lines. Websites, SEO and AI search visibility, Google Business Profile management and paid ads are offered as secondary services.

Simpl is built for B2B companies that sell high-ticket products, long-lasting services or big contracts to buildings, facilities and regulated businesses: low voltage, security and telecom integrators; senior living technology; building systems such as fire protection, commercial HVAC and elevators; facility services; healthcare technology; and manufacturers and distributors selling into those markets.

## What Simpl does

- Account Engine: a private, branded client portal (yourcompany.simpl.pro) with the client's whole market scored nightly from public records, a daily list of the best calls, decision makers by seat confirmed from public sources, proof linked on every fact, and team lists, pipeline, notes and exports
- CRM and follow-up: every account worth a call flows into the client's CRM (theirs or Simpl's) with an email and phone sequence that runs until the prospect replies or opts out (rolling out)
- AI receptionist and 24/7 support line: answers calls and tickets at any hour from the client's own guides and escalates urgent issues to whoever is on duty (rolling out)
- Websites, SEO and AI search visibility, Google Business Profile management, and paid ads management (client owns the ad account, no markup on spend)
- A free website and digital presence scan that scores a site 0 to 100 across six categories

## Pricing

- Account Engine: $10,000 one-time setup, then $1,000 per month
- Account Engine Pro: $15,000 one-time setup, then $2,500 per month; adds any territory up to nationwide, custom data sources, overnight research, CRM and follow-up, a 24/7 answering and support line, and a monthly strategy call
- Every prospect can see a free sample of their own top 25 accounts before paying anything
- Websites, SEO, Google Business Profile and ads are scoped and quoted per client

- Company: Simpl, simpl.pro, Raleigh, North Carolina, serving companies across the United States
- Contact: team@simpl.pro, (919) 428-9452
